title: 产品碳足迹
summary: 评估公司产品的全生命周期碳排放（含价值链上下游排放）及管理措施，适用于高排放制造业。

sections.title_en: Introduction
sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Product Carbon Footprint Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI’s),1 outputs are determined. Product Carbon Footprint is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the carbon intensity of their products and their ability to reduce the carbon footprint in their supply chains or in the use of their products and services.
blocks.content_cn: 本文档提供产品碳足迹关键议题组成部分的基本信息，帮助ESG评级用户理解MSCI可持续与气候（MSCI）¹研究输出的确定方式。产品碳足迹是MSCI ESG评级模型中环境支柱下的一个关键议题。公司评估内容包括其产品的碳强度，以及其在供应链中或产品和服务使用过程中减少碳足迹的能力。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: • Increased costs from higher and more volatile energy prices upstream in the value chain (affecting raw materials, input, and distribution costs).
blocks.content_cn: • 价值链上游能源价格上涨且波动加大带来的成本上升（影响原材料、投入品和分销成本）。

blocks.content: • Regulatory risks associated with downstream emissions, e.g., penalties resulting from vehicle fleet emissions standards in the automobile industry.
blocks.content_cn: • 与下游排放相关的监管风险，例如汽车行业因车队排放标准不达标而产生的处罚。

sections.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint Key Issue score
sections.title_cn: 产品碳足迹关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Product Carbon Footprint Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score on this Key Issue is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.
blocks.content_cn: 产品碳足迹关键议题得分评估公司对该关键议题风险的敞口程度以及风险管理质量。该关键议题得分基于敞口得分和管理得分通过下述公式综合得出。敞口得分与管理得分的结合方式为：敞口水平越高，需要展示的管理能力也越高，才能获得相同的总体关键议题得分。

If a company has no exposure to the business activities covered by an indicator, the indicator is assigned a weight of zero.

sections.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint Management score
sections.title_cn: 产品碳足迹管理得分

blocks.content: The Product Carbon Footprint Management score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on weighted average of the score associated with each relevant indicators, modified by controversies.
blocks.content_cn: 产品碳足迹管理得分评估公司管理该关键议题风险敞口的能力。它基于各相关指标得分的加权平均值计算，并经争议事件调整。

blocks.content: This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated.
blocks.content_cn: 该得分来源于按0-10分制评分的指标，10分对应最佳实践。更多细节请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"风险管理分析"部分。除特别注明外，数据来源为公司披露。

blocks.content: The definitions of the data points in each component are given below:
blocks.content_cn: 各组成部分中数据点的定义如下：

sections.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint Practices score
sections.title_cn: 产品碳足迹实践得分

blocks.content: The Product Carbon Footprint Practices score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks related to the carbon intensity of its products and its ability to reduce the carbon footprint in its supply chains or in the use of its products and services. This score is equal to the Product Carbon Footprint Management score and considers attributes of the company's policies and initiatives. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 产品碳足迹实践得分评估公司管理与产品碳强度相关风险敞口的能力，以及其在供应链中或产品和服务使用过程中减少碳足迹的能力。该得分等于产品碳足迹管理得分，并考虑公司政策和举措的属性。以0-10分表示，10分表示强有力的举措。

sections.title_en: • Assessment of energy consumption and/or carbon emissions of suppliers
sections.title_cn: • 对供应商能源消耗和／或碳排放的评估

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions and/or energy consumption of its suppliers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否评估其供应商的碳排放和/或能源消耗。

sections.title_en: • Extent of product carbon footprint assessments
sections.title_cn: • 产品碳足迹评估的开展程度

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the downstream carbon emissions of its products and services.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否评估其产品和服务的下游碳排放。

sections.title_en: • Targets to reduce Scope 3 upstream carbon emissions
sections.title_cn: • 减少范围3上游碳排放的目标

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there is evidence the company has quantitative and time-bound targets to reduce Scope 3 upstream carbon emissions. This may include targets regarding the company’s supply chain.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映是否有证据表明公司设定了减少范围3上游碳排放的量化、有时限的目标。这可能包括与公司供应链相关的目标。

sections.title_en: • Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of distribution and store operations
sections.title_cn: • 对配送及门店运营的能源消耗或碳排放的评估

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its distribution centers and store operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否评估其分销中心和门店运营的碳排放或能源消耗。

sections.title_en: • Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of manufacturing operations (including suppliers)
sections.title_cn: • 对制造运营（包括供应商）的能源消耗或碳排放的评估

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its manufacturing operations, including suppliers’ operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否评估其制造运营（包括供应商运营）的碳排放或能源消耗。

sections.title_en: • Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of raw materials sourcing
sections.title_cn: • 对原材料采购的能源消耗或碳排放的评估

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the upstream carbon emissions or energy consumption involved in the production of raw materials.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否评估原材料生产过程中涉及的上游碳排放或能源消耗。

sections.title_en: • Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of transportation and logistics
sections.title_cn: • 对运输及物流的能源消耗或碳排放的评估

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its transportation and logistics operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司是否评估其运输和物流运营的碳排放或能源消耗。

sections.title_en: • Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in distribution centers or store operations
sections.title_cn: • 配送中心或门店运营中降低能源消耗或碳排放项目的实施程度

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in its distribution centers or store operations. Best practice includes programs in all distribution centers or store operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在其分销中心或门店运营中实施碳减排或节能项目的程度。最佳实践包括在所有分销中心或门店运营中实施项目。

sections.title_en: • Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in manufacturing operations (including suppliers)
sections.title_cn: • 制造运营（包括供应商）中降低能源消耗或碳排放项目的实施程度

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in its manufacturing operations, including suppliers’ operations. Best practice includes programs covering all core production facilities.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在其制造运营（包括供应商运营）中实施碳减排或节能项目的程度。最佳实践包括项目覆盖所有核心生产设施。

sections.title_en: • Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in raw materials sourcing
sections.title_cn: • 原材料采购中降低能源消耗或碳排放项目的实施程度

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in the sourcing of raw materials, including those sourced by suppliers. Best practice includes programs covering all core products.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在原材料采购（包括供应商采购的原材料）中实施碳减排或节能项目的程度。最佳实践包括项目覆盖所有核心产品。

sections.title_en: • Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in transportation and logistics
sections.title_cn: • 运输及物流中降低能源消耗或碳排放项目的实施程度

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in the transportation and logistics stages. Best practice includes improvements in fleet efficiency combined with improvements in load/packaging optimization.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在运输和物流阶段实施碳减排或节能项目的程度。最佳实践包括车队效率提升与装载/包装优化相结合。

blocks.content: Sources: Company disclosures, CDP, International Council on Clean Transportation, Environmental Protection Agency, European Environment Agency, Korea Energy Industry.
blocks.content_cn: 数据来源：公司披露、CDP（碳披露项目）、国际清洁交通理事会、美国环保署、欧洲环境署、韩国能源产业。

sections.title_en: For the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry:
sections.title_cn: 对于汽车和摩托车制造业：

blocks.content: For companies belonging to the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry, the Product Carbon Footprint Management score is calculated using the Product Carbon Footprint Performance score and the Product Carbon Footprint Performance Targets score.
blocks.content_cn: 对于属于汽车和摩托车制造业的公司，产品碳足迹管理得分使用产品碳足迹绩效得分和产品碳足迹绩效目标得分计算。

blocks.content: The definitions of the data points in each component are given below:
blocks.content_cn: 各组成部分中数据点的定义如下：

sections.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint Performance score
sections.title_cn: 产品碳足迹绩效得分

blocks.content: The Product Carbon Footprint Performance score evaluates the company's performance on Product Carbon Footprint metrics, including the company’s estimated tailpipe emissions. It is expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 产品碳足迹绩效得分评估公司在产品碳足迹指标上的表现，包括公司估计的尾气排放。以0-10分表示，10分表示最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: • Tailpipe fleet emission performance relative to peers
sections.title_cn: • 相对于同业的车队尾气排放绩效

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission performance in comparison to industry peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating lowest fleet emissions, relative to peers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司估计的全球按销量加权的尾气车队排放表现与行业同行相比的情况。以0-10分表示，10分表示相对同行车队排放最低。

sections.title_en: ◦ Product Carbon Footprint industry relative score
sections.title_cn: ◦ 产品碳足迹的行业相对得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates lowest fleet emissions relative to peers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司估计的全球按销量加权的尾气车队排放相对同行的表现。以0-10分表示，10分表示相对同行车队排放最低。

blocks.content: ◦ Product Carbon Footprint industry relative trend score
blocks.content_cn: ◦ 产品碳足迹行业相对趋势得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-overyear estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates highest decline in fleet emissions, relative to peers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司估计的全球按销量加权的尾气车队排放三年平均同比变化趋势相对同行的表现。以0-10分表示，10分表示相对同行车队排放下降幅度最大。

blocks.content: Sources: Company disclosures; European Environment Agency (EEA), DISCODATA Database; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), Energy and Information Data Center; U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Automotive Trends Data
blocks.content_cn: 数据来源：公司披露；欧洲环境署（EEA）DISCODATA数据库；工业和信息化部（MIIT）能源与信息数据中心；美国环保署（EPA）汽车趋势数据

sections.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint Targets score
sections.title_cn: 产品碳足迹目标得分

blocks.content: The Product Carbon Footprint Targets score evaluates the company’s initiatives to set, pursue and verify carbon emissions targets. Highest initiatives reflect comprehensive, independently verified targets with strong progress toward achievement. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 产品碳足迹目标得分评估公司设定、推进并验证碳减排目标的举措。最高举措反映为全面、经独立验证且取得良好进展的目标。以0-10分表示，10分表示强有力的举措。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness
sections.title_cn: • 碳排放目标的全面性

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company has established quantitative climate targets that are comprehensive in scope and complete in coverage. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating comprehensive targets.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司建立的量化气候目标在范围和覆盖面上的全面程度。以0-10分表示，10分表示目标全面。

blocks.content: ◦ Carbon emissions target footprint coverage (%)
blocks.content_cn: ◦ 碳减排目标足迹覆盖率（%）

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company’s emission reduction targets cover its total reported emissions. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates that the targets comprehensively cover all relevant emissions.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司减排目标覆盖其总报告排放量的程度。以0-10分表示，10分表示目标全面覆盖所有相关排放。

blocks.content: ◦ Carbon emissions target relevant scope score
blocks.content_cn: ◦ 碳减排目标相关范围得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses whether the company’s emission reduction targets include all financially material scopes. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates full coverage of financially material emission scopes.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司减排目标是否涵盖所有财务重要范围的排放。以0-10分表示，10分表示完全覆盖财务重要排放范围。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions target progress
sections.title_cn: • 碳排放目标的进展

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward active environmental targets, as well as its historical track record in meeting previously stated targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong progress towards targets
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司实现现行环境目标的进展，以及其达成先前设定目标的历史记录。以0-10分表示，10分表示向目标取得良好进展。

blocks.content: ◦ Carbon emissions ongoing target progress
blocks.content_cn: ◦ 碳减排进行中目标进展

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward achieving its emission reduction targets based on current performance. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 all its targets are on track to meet stated targets.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：基于当前表现评估公司实现减排目标的进展。以0-10分表示，10分表示所有目标均在按计划实现。

blocks.content: ◦ Carbon emissions target track record
blocks.content_cn: ◦ 碳减排目标历史记录

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s historical performance in achieving or maintaining sustainability or environmental targets. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司在实现或维持可持续发展/环境目标方面的历史表现。以0-10分表示，10分表示表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions target verification
sections.title_cn: • 碳排放目标的验证

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses whether the company’s disclosed targets are supported by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), where applicable. Expressed as either NULL or 10 score, with 10 indicating presence of verification.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司披露的目标是否得到科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）（如适用）的支持。取值为NULL或10分，10分表示已获验证。

blocks.content: ◦ SBTi long-term target status
blocks.content_cn: ◦ SBTi长期目标状态

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) long-term target, aligned with net-zero or long-term decarbonization goals.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）长期目标的状态，该目标与净零或长期脱碳目标保持一致。

blocks.content: ◦ SBTi near-term target status
blocks.content_cn: ◦ SBTi近期目标状态

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) near-term target, aligned with short- to medium-term emissions reduction goals.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：反映公司科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）近期目标的状态，该目标与短期至中期减排目标保持一致。

sections.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint Exposure score
sections.title_cn: 产品碳足迹风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Product Carbon Footprint Exposure score evaluates the company’s exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business Exposure scores only, except for the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry. For the automobile and motorcycle manufacturing industry, it is based on the Business Exposure score and the Geographic Exposure score. The Business Exposure score is scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. sections.title_en: Business Segment Exposure scores
sections.title_cn: 业务板块敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure score is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score.
blocks.content_cn: 业务板块敞口得分基于公司披露的业务板块与相应业务活动的映射确定。MSCI S&C使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系并结合行业特定调整来定义业务活动。与业务活动相关的得分用于计算业务板块敞口得分。

blocks.content: Each business activity score is determined by a qualitative assessment of specific vehicle class emissions and vehicle weights in a business activity. The highest resulting Business Exposure scores correspond to the passenger vehicle classes with the highest emissions intensities and vehicle weights. Passenger vehicle classes are generally considered to face stricter regulations than commercial vehicles or two-wheelers.
blocks.content_cn: 每项业务活动得分通过对业务活动中特定车辆类别的排放和车辆重量进行定性评估来确定。业务敞口得分最高的对应乘用车类别，其排放强度和车辆重量最高。乘用车类别通常被认为比商用车或两轮车面临更严格的监管。

blocks.content: The Geographic Segment Exposure score is determined by regulatory requirements for vehicle carbon emissions or fuel efficiency in specific locations. Stricter regulatory requirements for vehicle carbon emissions or fuel efficiency indicates higher Geographic Segment Exposure score.
blocks.content_cn: 地理板块敞口得分由特定地区对车辆碳排放或燃油效率的监管要求决定。对车辆碳排放或燃油效率更严格的监管要求表示地理板块敞口得分更高。

sections.title_en: Data sources
sections.title_cn: 数据来源

blocks.content: The following sources are used to determine the Product Carbon Footprint Business Exposure score: IERS’ Comprehensive Environmental Data Archive (CEDA), Refinitiv, MSCI S&C, company disclosures.
blocks.content_cn: 用于确定产品碳足迹业务敞口得分的来源包括：IERS综合环境数据档案（CEDA）、Refinitiv、MSCI S&C、公司披露。
